title: The Cracked Colossus
description: A surreal scene depicts a massive cracked stone statue of a man dominating the background, its body embedded with framed portraits and television sets. In the foreground, two women in black dresses stand on the giant's outstretched hand interacting with an old television, while a hooded figure addresses a large crowd of identical blue silhouettes below.
prompt: Surreal dystopian painting of a gigantic cracked stone colossus of a stern man towering over a scene, its torso covered in framed portraits and old televisions. Two women in 1950s black dresses stand on the giant's huge open hand, one adjusting an old CRT television showing an old man's face. A hooded figure stands before a vast crowd of uniform blue silhouettes. Cracks, dripping water, hanging lamp, oppressive atmosphere, detailed textures.
